# Floor-selector fixtures

`hard_vertical.png` and `nightmare_vertical.png` are HUD-only crops from the
November 7, 2026 game screenshots supplied for debugging. They exclude player
names and map contents and exercise the vertical S0 selector at several sizes.
Game artwork remains the property of its respective owner; see
`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`. S1 tests use synthetic selectors and do not establish
accuracy on real S1 game captures.
